subject: Post-demo: Redwood Inference buying committee recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@acmeai.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Redwood Inference buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Elena (and team),

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the thoughtful questions from the buying committee. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

What we covered
- Demoed production inference flow: routing, autoscaling, and latency controls
- Observability and per-route billing in the Console
- Security: private deployment options, KMS integrations, and SOC2 overview
- Cost controls: batching/quantization recommendations and expected unit cost ranges for your query profile

Decision criteria Elena shared
- Predictable latency at 95th pct under 300ms
- SOC2 compliance + ability to host within us-east region
- Support for model version pinning and canary rollouts
- Clear unit economics for projected 20M tokens/mo

Action items / next steps
1) Marissa: share the demo deck, a tailored pricing proposal, and SOC2 summary (attached). Target: today EOD.
2) Acme: confirm procurement timeline and any required PO/contracting terms.
3) Security (Tom): share any additional compliance questionnaire items — we can respond within 48 hours.
4) Schedule a 30-min follow-up for procurement/legal and a 1-hr technical design review with your infra team. Suggested times below.

Suggested cadence / timeline
- Procurement/legal sync: Thu 25 Feb, 10:00—10:30 PT (or Tue 2 Mar)
- Technical design review (engineering + security): Tue 2 Mar, 11:00—12:00 PT
- Target decision window: by EOW Mar 12 (your target)

Attachments: 20270224-redwood-demo-deck.pdf, redwood-pricing-proposal-ACME-2027.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf

If there are any gaps in the recap, call them out and I’ll update. Happy to move the procurement sync — appreciative if you can loop in procurement contact (I’ve tentatively included procurement@acmeai.com).

Thanks \u2014
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

1) SOC2: can you confirm the date of the most recent SOC2 Type II report and whether Redwood will allow us to sign an NDA to review the full report?

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood Inference buying committee recap & next steps

Elena / Tom / Procurement team — thanks for the quick replies and for the attached questionnaire Tom. Short answers and next steps below so you can circulate internally.

Quick answers:
- SOC2: most recent SOC2 Type II report completed Nov 2026. We can sign an NDA and provide the full report within 24 hours after NDA execution. Summary attached (SOC2-summary.pdf).
- Data residency: yes — we support region pinning for Dedicated and Private deployments (us-east-1 available). For Hosted API we have routing policies and a private VPC option; logs/audit exports can be restricted to region with our Private deployment.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers and HSM integrations; key rotation is supported with rolling updates to avoid downtime.

Follow-ups / deliverables (I’ll own unless noted):
1) Send month-by-month 12-month spend schedule for 20M token profile — Nikhil will include this in the pricing workbook and share by EOD Thu. (Nikhil)
2) Draft contract + SOW: I’ll attach a redline-friendly template and our standard MSA; Laura can handle legal escalations if any term needs exec sign-off. Target: Thu EOD. (Marissa + Laura)
3) Security questionnaire: we’ll complete and return Tom’s attached questionnaire within 48 hours. (Marissa / Security SME)
4) Schedule procurement sync: Thu 25 Feb, 10:00—10:30 PT — Elena / procurement, confirm or propose alternate.
5) Technical design review: Tue 2 Mar, 11:00—12:00 PT — Nikhil to lead with our infra engineer.

Attachments: 20270224-redwood-demo-deck.pdf, redwood-pricing-proposal-ACME-2027.xlsx (pricing workbook will be updated), SOC2-summary.pdf

If that all looks good I’ll proceed and send the contract + updated pricing. Appreciate the fast turnaround from your side — we’ll prioritize the security questionnaire.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
